'The planned talks between the US, Iran, Qatar and Pakistan have been postponed,' the ministry said. 'Switzerland remains ready to facilitate these talks. The relevant preparatory work at Burgenstock is continuing,' it added. The ministry did not provide a new date for the talks. The announcement came after the White House said on Thursday that US President JD Vance would not be departing for Switzerland as initially scheduled.
